_comment: Selenium + C# + Reqnroll BDD template. Mirrors the Selenium/Java/Cucumber layout (ConfigReader + DriverFactory + Hooks + PageObjects + StepDefinitions + a runnable login sample) but in C# using Reqnroll (the maintained SpecFlow successor) on NUnit, Selenium 4 (with the built-in Selenium Manager, so no WebDriverManager needed), and DotNetEnv for .env config. The seeder (deploy_team_templates.py) ingests this directory verbatim and creates a ProjectTemplates row keyed by (tool, language, framework). The UI offers this as Selenium / C# / Reqnroll / NuGet.
description: Enterprise Selenium C# Reqnroll BDD Template (NUnit + Selenium 4 + DotNetEnv)
